# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_CONVERGENCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price retraces to VWAP during a bullish EMA ribbon alignment on declining volume, the resumption of the trend offers a high‑probability long entry. This captures pull‑back‑to‑VWAP longs that are distinct from breakout continuations.

## Mechanism

Enter long when: (1) EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish ribbon), (2) price crosses above VWAP from below on the current bar, (3) volume on the bar is less than the average volume of the previous 20 bars, and (4) the prior bar closed below VWAP. Exit: initial stop at the swing low of the entry bar or 0.5% below entry, whichever is wider; take profit at 1.5R, then trail remaining position with a 12% chandelier exit based on ATR(14). Regime filter: VIX < 18 and time 09:45‑11:30 EST; avoid FOMC/minute‑level news.
